answer: Sybil resistance by guardian-set bonds: registration needs k guardians from distinct clusters, each bonded, each capped at a few wards ever. The public guardian graph exposes a farm as one tight knoll of shared sponsors. Honest guardians ration their slots - backing a terrace risks their bond - and when a ward cheats, every sponsor's jade slashes too. Sponsorship is priced like underwriting, and farms find no underwriters.
